subject: Re: Project Basalt kickoff — open-vocabulary detection
body:
Hi Lucia,

Basalt staffing: Umar 60% (research lead), Farah 50% (serving path), Katya 30% (evals), Ondrej 40% (training infra).

Compute: modest by detection standards precisely because the VLM backbone is frozen — detector-head training fits on 128 A100s on titan best-effort, no vulcan reservation needed this quarter. We will pull the released r50, r50x4 and r50x16 checkpoints and restore from the FLAX versions rather than the tf.SavedModel path.

Dependency: Shipyard capacity for the demo endpoint — I have asked Zeke for a slot ahead of the Jun 17 LRB demo.

Flag: the r50x16 restore wants 80GB cards; Ondrej is checking our host mix.

Deshawn
